description: Baseline shooting fundamentals shown to every user before their first session, regardless of what the pose analysis later detects.

cues.title: Stance
cues.cue: Feet shoulder-width apart, shooting-side foot slightly ahead, weight on the balls of your feet.

cues.title: Hand Placement
cues.cue: Shooting hand behind/under the ball in the shot pocket. Guide hand on the side of the ball, not under it or pushing it.

cues.title: Face the Basket
cues.cue: Shoulders and hips squared directly to the rim.

cues.title: Eyes on Target
cues.cue: Lock onto the target (front or back of rim) before you start your motion, and stay locked through release.

cues.title: Elbow Position
cues.cue: Elbow tucked under the ball, stacked below the wrist, not flared out to the side.

cues.title: One Fluid Motion
cues.cue: The ball rises straight from the gather into the shot, no pause at the set point.

cues.title: Release Timing
cues.cue: Release on the way up. Never release on the way down.

cues.title: Follow-Through
cues.cue: Wrist snaps down, fingers point at the target, hold the follow-through until the ball hits the rim.

cues.title: Landing
cues.cue: Land balanced, ideally back where you jumped from.
